newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal refinery unaffected after nearby fire.
newsitem.headline: Portugal refinery unaffected after nearby fire.

text.p: A fire was extinguished at a motor oil factory of state oil company Petrogal in Matosinhos in northern Portugal early on Thursday, and the nearby oil refinery was unaffected and operating normally, firemen said.
"Just the motor oil factory was affected. Activity is normal in the remainder of the complex," the spokesman told Reuters.
He said the cause of the fire, which forced the closure of the factory, was not known and that there was some material damage, but no casualties.
Spokesmen at Petrogal and the refinery were not immediately available.
